# Integrating tom_som_java_v0

<!-- GENERATED by tom_specs_clitool generate_som — do not edit by hand. -->

`tom_som_java_v0` is the typed TomSpecs object-model facade for Java. It depends on `tom_som_java_runtime`. Both are versioned to the TomSpecs **model version** (currently `1.0.0`) — pin to that version so your document reads and writes match the model the facade was generated from.

## Quick start

Add `tom_som_java_v0` (group `io.github.al-the-bear`) to your Maven `pom.xml`, then:

```java
import tom_som_runtime.SpecDocument;
import tom_som_java_v0.TomSomV0;

// A typed Solution Blueprint over a fresh document.
SpecDocument doc = new SpecDocument();
TomSomV0.D00SolutionBlueprint blueprint = new TomSomV0.D00SolutionBlueprint(doc);

blueprint.content("A platform that unifies our fragmented order systems.");
blueprint.currentLandscape()
    .content("Three legacy systems with no shared customer record.");

System.out.println(blueprint.content());
```

## Dependency routes

### From a Maven repository

Declare the dependency (it pulls in `tom_som_java_runtime`):

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>io.github.al-the-bear</groupId>
  <artifactId>tom_som_java_v0</artifactId>
  <version>VERSION</version>
</dependency>
```

### Local install (mvn install)

When the SOM projects sit alongside your build, install both into your local `~/.m2` repository, runtime first:

```bash
cd ../tom_som_java_runtime && mvn install
cd ../tom_som_java_v0 && mvn install
```

### JAR fallback (no Maven)

On a JDK-only host, build the JARs with the bundled scripts (runtime first — the facade compiles against it):

```bash
cd ../tom_som_java_runtime && ./build_jar.sh
cd ../tom_som_java_v0 && ./build_jar.sh
```

Each writes `build/<artifact>-<version>.jar`. Put both on your `javac`/`java` classpath.

## Pinning the version

Both `tom_som_java_runtime` and `tom_som_java_v0` carry version `1.0.0`, taken from the TomSpecs model version. When you upgrade the model, regenerate and move to the new matching version so the facade and your stored documents stay in step.

## Building from source

Regenerate the facade and build the JARs from the workspace:

```bash
dart run tom_specs_clitool/bin/generate_som.dart
# Maven, if available:
cd tom_som_java_v0 && mvn package
# or the JDK-only fallback (runtime first):
cd tom_som_java_runtime && ./build_jar.sh
cd ../tom_som_java_v0 && ./build_jar.sh
```
